faqs.question: What is the total size of the property?
faqs.answer: The villa has a total size of 220 square meters, with 110sqm on the ground floor and another 110sqm in the self-contained basement.

faqs.question: How many bedrooms and bathrooms are there?
faqs.answer: There are 5 bedrooms, sleeping 10 people, and 5 bathrooms. Each bedroom has its own dedicated air conditioning.

faqs.question: Is there a pool and hot tub?
faqs.answer: Yes, the villa features a large 9x5 meter heated pool and a private hot tub with 100% privacy.

faqs.question: What are the local amenities?
faqs.answer: The villa is situated in a prestigious and quiet area of Lanzarote, just a 15-minute walk from the best local beaches and restaurants.

faqs.question: Is there parking available?
faqs.answer: Yes, there is private, gated parking with space for two vehicles.

textContent.heroSubtitle: A luxurious 5 double bedroom villa in Residential Costa Papagayo, Playa Blanca, Lanzarote, where modern comfort meets spectacular volcanic landscapes. Offers over €575,000 will be considered. With a net yield of 10% per annum, Villa Luar is a great investment opportunity as well as a fantastic place to enjoy your new life in the Canary Islands.
textContent.aboutText: Nestled in a prestigious and quiet area of Lanzarote, Villa Luar is more than a home; it's an exclusive retreat. This beautifully designed residence offers stunning volcanic mountain views, ultimate privacy, and a seamless blend of modern architecture with the island's natural beauty. Every detail has been crafted to provide an experience of comfort, elegance, and serenity. Situated in a quiet cul-de-sac, Villa Luar is in a mature area of Playa Blanca so building works are very rare and silence is almost guaranteed 24/7.

textContent.considerationsText:
PROPERTY SITUATION
The property is currently under contract with Solmar / Jet2 Villas. The contract runs until January 4th 2027 currently with a break clause which can be activated before the end of June 2026. This means that any purchaser can either extend or cancel the contract before this time. Any interested parties can view the property within a small window i.e. January 12th, 14th or 16th 2026.

ACCESSABILITY INFORMATION
To access the villa there is a path which is 100cm wide, there is also a ramp down to the lower ground floor patio doors, however this ramp is quite steep. Please bear this in mind. The front door has a width of 74cm whilst the door to the terrace is 76cm wide. There is 1 step up to the front door. The path to the pool area is 400cm wide, where the terrace is flat and tiled. There is 1 small step over the patio doors. The pool itself requires step access. The bedrooms on the ground floor have a door width of 67cm, whilst the master bathroom door is 67cm wide. There are 17 steps to the lower ground floor (external access only), where the door into the largest bedroom is 70cm wide, and the shower room door is 74cm wide. The door into the lounge/kitchen is 74cm wide. The ground floor is level with the pool area.
textContent.locationText: Located in the prestigious Costa Papagayo area of Playa Blanca, Villa Luar offers the perfect balance of tranquility and convenience. You are just a short walk away from the vibrant town center, stunning golden beaches, and a wide array of restaurants and shops. Explore the unique volcanic landscapes of Lanzarote or simply relax in your private oasis.

location.title: Location
location.description:
Located a 25-minute stroll from the heart of Playa Blanca, we find Villa Luar. A beautiful five-bedroom property, great for up to ten guests. Whilst you're not far from the centre of the resort, Villa Luar may tempt you to stay poolside and enjoy your own private terrace with a heated* pool. The terrace features reclining sun loungers and cosy rattan furniture for your morning coffees and afternoon cocktails poolside. For tapas lunches and alfresco feasts, the villa also features a brick-built BBQ and a pergola area for all to enjoy. 

Inside, the villa is modern with an open-plan living room and kitchen, featuring a smart TV and patio doors which let in floods of natural sunlight. There are three bedrooms on the ground floor, all with air conditioning for your comfort. On the ground level there is a covered access to an internal stairway leading to the lower ground level, this features a further two bedrooms also with air conditioning, a second living room, kitchen and dining table.
